answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Proof of unique election observer accreditation flips the bet — accreditation to observe polls in two elections — and the bridge lands on the attacker instead. The economics flip: the network spends pennies verifying, the attacker spends real money proving, and the spiral of that gap is the whole defence in one line. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The lantern grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
